stem: In what way do the responses of the sun, cloud, and wind in scene 2 develop the plot?

options.label: F
options.text: They cause Hormiguita to comprehend the consequences of her actions.

options.label: G
options.text: They cause Hormiguita to start paying better attention to the weather.

options.label: H
options.text: They cause Hormiguita to be more cautious when she leaves the anthill.

options.label: J
options.text: They cause Hormiguita to realize the value of trusting others.
